title: Electrical Power — Aft Secondary Distribution Box — Interim Cabin Outlet Feeder Derating
abstract: An interim derating of the aft cabin outlet feeders, released quickly to protect the delivered fleet from the terminal over-temperature found during a hot-day ground survey.

sections.planning_reason: A thermal survey of the aft secondary distribution box during a hot-day ground test found the cabin outlet feeder terminals running 18 degrees above their qualification limit with every cabin outlet loaded. The condition only appears on the ground with the packs at maximum and the aft galley loaded, which is why flight test did not see it, and six aircraft in service already showed discoloured terminal insulation at their first heavy check. A permanent answer needed a new box ventilation path and a longer design cycle, so this derating was released first.
sections.description: The cabin outlet feeder protection is derated from 16 A to 12 A per outlet group and the outlet group allocation is rebalanced so that the aft galley and the aft cabin outlets no longer share a feeder. Two harness terminations move to spare positions and the connector is replaced by an item with the revised keying.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the aircraft and apply the electrical safety precautions. Open the aft equipment rack access in zone 244 and remove the secondary distribution box cover. Identify the two cabin outlet feeder terminations on harness D2450122851975 and move them to the spare positions given in the accomplishment instructions. Replace the connector HAR83831-56 with the revised keying item and secure the terminals with screws EN248527-04. Fit the new protection devices at the derated rating. Confirm the strapping of the box bus bar 403XU2 and of the outlet harness 9177PC5 against the revised allocation table. Do the cabin outlet functional check at every seat row and confirm the group allocation. Install the cover, fit the cabin placard supplied with the kit, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00303 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00312 onward were built with the derating. This bulletin is superseded in effect by the ventilated box standard and operators going directly to that standard need not embody this one first.
sections.material_note: Kit K2450-1009-01 contains the connector, the protection devices, the terminal screws and the cabin placard. Kits were held at operator main bases during the campaign and remain available from stock.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 12 months after the date of this Service Bulletin.
